A '''hovervan''', or '''repulsorlift van''', was a [[Hovercraft|ground-effect vehicle.]] It was used for transporting beings and material.

Hovervans were employed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].

The armored [[HL-38 armored hovervan|HL-38]] and the [[GX12 Hovervan|GX12]] were two models of hovervan.
